guards: every TERMINAL upstream report carries a disposition that resolves — a doctor probe id, a tracked regression test, or a written exemption

poisonPill.why: A ledger entry citing a probe id the doctor registry no longer has — the exact drift a probe rename or retirement would produce silently otherwise. This is the SILENT variant: the file parses as valid JSON, every OTHER entry is untouched, and without this gate the ratchet would report a closed upstream report as covered when its cited probe has quietly stopped existing. `needsGit` (round-2 audit H6): the isolated copy gets a REAL git repo (init+add+commit of the tracked file set) so `check-upstream-probe-coverage.mjs`'s `git ls-files` call succeeds for real, rather than the gate needing a filesystem-walk fallback that could not prove tracking.
